theme: Three days of intentional gratitude — training the eye to see what's good

days.task: Write 10 specific gratitudes — not generic. Go deeper than 'my health and family.' Find the specific.
Tell one person specifically what you're grateful for about them. Not a text — say it or write it fully.
Find something genuinely difficult in your life right now. Write what it has given you, taught you, or opened in you.
